faqs.question: Is Growatt inverter good for Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Yes. Growatt is one of the world's largest solar inverter manufacturers and is widely regarded as an excellent choice for Pakistan. Growatt inverters handle voltage fluctuations common on the Pakistani grid, come with a 5-year warranty (extendable to 10), and have strong local service support in Lahore, Islamabad, and across Punjab.

faqs.question: Growatt vs Fronus inverter — which is better?
faqs.answer: Both are reliable choices for Pakistan's conditions. Growatt is a global brand with greater international R&D investment and the most widely deployed inverter in Pakistan. Fronus is a local brand with strong after-sales service networks in Pakistan and competitive pricing. Solarlink recommends Growatt for export-heavy systems and Fronus for budget-conscious residential installations.

faqs.question: What is the price of Growatt inverter in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Growatt inverter prices in Pakistan range from approximately PKR 65,000 for a 3kW on-grid model to PKR 250,000+ for a 10kW hybrid model. Prices vary based on model, capacity, and whether it's a standard on-grid or hybrid (battery-ready) configuration. Contact Solarlink for the latest pricing tailored to your system size.
